qs.q: During the evaluation of a knee joint injury, a clinician identifies a bursa located specifically between the patella and the skin. What is the name of this bursa?
qs.e: The prepatellar bursa is located between the patella and the overlying skin. The suprapatellar bursa lies superior to the patella beneath the quadriceps tendon.

qs.q: A 28-year-old athlete presents with anterior knee pain and lateral tracking of the patella. Which anatomical structure primarily provides active dynamic restraint against lateral patellar displacement during extension?
o: Long head of biceps femoris tendon
qs.e: The oblique fibers of the vastus medialis pull the patella medially to counteract the lateral pull of the quadriceps mechanism. The biceps femoris is a knee flexor and hip extensor located posteriorly that does not dynamically resist lateral patellar tracking.
